```lean
induction s with xs IH using Finset.induction_on with xs IH
· rw [Finset.card_empty, multichoose_zero]
· rw [Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem (Finset.not_mem_of_not_subset (Finset.subset_antisymm_iff.1 (Finset.subset.refl _)))]
  simp only [Finset.insert_eq, Finset.finsuppAntidiag_insert, Finset.finsuppAntidiag_map]
  rw [Finset.card_image]
  refine le_antisymm (le_trans (IH _) _) _
  · rw [Finset.card_image]
    exact Nat.le_add_left (IH _) _
  · rw [Finset.card_image]
    exact Nat.add_le_add_right (IH _) _
  rw [multichoose_insert]
  congr'
  · exact (Finset.card_insert_of_not_mem (Finset.not_mem_of_not_subset (Finset.subset_antisymm_iff.1 (Finset.subset.refl _)))).symm
  · rw [Finset.card_image]
    exact Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.zero_le _) _
```
